I couldn't get the live price from Apple's store. The fetch of apple.com was blocked, and search only returned older third-party articles.

What those articles say about the M4 MacBook Air in the US:
- **List price at launch (2025):** $999 for the 13-inch and $1,199 for the 15-inch, according to [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2303200/m4-macbook-air-design-price-specs-release.html). The base 13-inch has 16GB RAM and 256GB storage.
- **Upgraded configurations:** 512GB storage and 24GB RAM options ran from $1,199 to $1,599 across both sizes, per the same Macworld table.
- **Retailer discounts:** [MacPrices](https://www.macprices.net/2025/05/07/apples-m4-powered-macbook-airs-are-on-sale-for-150-off-msrp-this-week-starting-at-only-849/) reported the base 13-inch at $849 in May 2025. [AppleInsider](https://appleinsider.com/articles/25/12/26/amazon-slashes-250-off-m4-macbook-air-models-prices-from-749) reported Amazon at $749.99 in December 2025.

Today is October 16, 2026, so these figures are at least ten months old. Apple may have changed the lineup or prices since then, for example by replacing the M4 model. Check apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-air for the current price.
